description: The current ZEC ETF flows indicator: a daily BUY / HOLD / SELL signal for Zcash built from creations and redemptions in US spot Zcash ETFs (Grayscale ZCSH), scored together with premium to NAV, derivatives leverage and funding, spot taker imbalance, open interest trend, shielded pool growth, volume share, SEC EDGAR filings and the price regime. Returns the signal, total score, each component's score and reason, the raw inputs, an LLM-written rationale (it may only downgrade the computed signal), the tracked funds and recent classified filings. Recomputed once a day after the US close; "stale" is true when the ETF data is more than two business days old. Informational only, not investment advice.
name: get_zec_etf_signal
title: ZEC ETF flows signal (today)
